summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 58:12 Global Connect CRM - Phase 3 Major Overhaul. All 25 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features tested and working: Compass system (renamed from branches), multi-currency locations, new role hierarchy, CSV imports, chat with Gemini AI, fund distribution, resource types with bookable/staff-only flags.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 3 features working.
